paragraphs.text: Job never spoke these words: but because he maintained his innocency, it seemed as though he would say, that God tormented him without just cause.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Such as are in the same error.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: If you cannot control the clouds, will you presume to instruct God?
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: clouds which are higher than thou

paragraphs.text: Neither does your sin hurt God, nor your justice profit him: for he will be glorified without you.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: The wicked may hurt man and cause him to cry, who if he sought God who lends comfort would be delivered.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Because they pray not in faith, as feeling God's mercies.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: God is just, however you judge him.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: For if he punished you as you deserved, you would not be able to open your mouth.
paragraphs.label: h
